mapper.insert: INSERT INTO itinerary_place (itin_no, place_no, day_order, order_in_day, move_type, move_minutes) VALUES (#{itinNo}, #{placeNo}, #{dayOrder}, #{orderInDay}, #{moveType}, #{moveMinutes})
mapper.select: SELECT ip.itin_place_no AS itinPlaceNo, ip.itin_no AS itinNo, ip.day_order AS dayOrder, ip.order_in_day AS orderInDay, ip.move_type AS moveType, ip.move_minutes AS moveMinutes, p.place_no AS placeNo, p.content_id AS contentId, p.content_type_id AS contentTypeId, p.title AS title, p.addr1 AS addr1, p.addr2 AS addr2, p.mapx AS mapx, p.mapy AS mapy, p.first_image AS firstImage, p.first_image2 AS firstImage2, p.rating AS rating FROM itinerary_place ip JOIN place p ON ip.place_no = p.place_no WHERE ip.itin_no = #{itinNo} ORDER BY ip.day_order ASC, ip.order_in_day ASC
